purpose: Define one cabinet-wide machine meaning for healthcare, security-checkpoint and other roleplay metaphors so presentation language cannot silently expand authority, imply professional credentials, alter evidence state or trigger unsafe mutation.
primeLaw: displayMetaphor -> machineMeaning -> allowedActions -> forbiddenInterpretations -> evidenceGate -> authorityCeiling

quarantine.machineMeaning: Reversible isolation of an artifact, candidate, response, dependency or task output pending review.
quarantine.evidenceGate: Exact target identity and reversible-location or state receipt required before claiming quarantine occurred.
quarantine.authorityCeiling: Does not grant delete, purge, publish, merge, deploy or Crown authority.

diagnosis.machineMeaning: Evidence-backed explanation of a technical condition, failure, contradiction or risk.
diagnosis.evidenceGate: Observed evidence and exact task/source/scope identity required.

symptom.machineMeaning: Observed technical behavior or externally visible failure signal.
symptom.evidenceGate: Observation must be source- or runtime-bound.

pathology.machineMeaning: Recurring technical failure pattern, structural defect pattern or evidence-integrity problem.
pathology.evidenceGate: Pattern requires more than one supporting observation unless deterministic proof identifies the defect directly.

triage.machineMeaning: Prioritize technical work, evidence or incidents by urgency, dependency and consequence.
triage.evidenceGate: Priority rationale must be stated for consequential work.

treatment.machineMeaning: Proposed technical repair, mitigation or configuration change.
treatment.evidenceGate: Repair remains proposal until authorized and tested.
treatment.authorityCeiling: No source mutation, deployment or Crown by metaphor.

prognosis.machineMeaning: Expected technical outcome if an observed condition continues or a proposed repair is applied.

prescription.machineMeaning: Legacy presentation synonym for a technical recommendation.
prescription.evidenceGate: Must resolve to recommendedAction in machine state.

patient.machineMeaning: Legacy metaphor for a workflow or system under diagnosis.
patient.evidenceGate: Must never be used as machine identity for a person.

clinical.evidenceGate: Any legal or standards compliance claim requires separate exact evidence.
clinical.authorityCeiling: Presentation does not grant professional authority.

doctorGoddess.machineMeaning: Urd's systems diagnosis and evidence-risk specialist persona.
doctorGoddess.evidenceGate: Role is bounded by Urd skill and exact task envelope.
doctorGoddess.authorityCeiling: Read-only advisory role unless a separate deterministic executor is authorized.

tsa.machineMeaning: Authenticated Zero Trust access checkpoint in LuHm architecture.
tsa.evidenceGate: Live access state requires runtime receipt.
tsa.authorityCeiling: Metaphor grants no network mutation authority.

sterileArea.machineMeaning: Bounded authenticated service side after identity, policy and TLS checks.
sterileArea.evidenceGate: Trust boundary claims require exact architecture and runtime evidence.

humanSafety.law: Cabinet healthcare-flavored metaphors describe LuHm systems and workflows only. They do not diagnose, treat, triage, prescribe for or medically classify Professor or any person.

historicalEvidenceLaw: Historical files and receipts keep original wording. New/current interpretation uses this semantic boundary and does not retroactively rewrite evidence.
